name: cold-email
description: Cold email and LinkedIn outreach for B2B prospecting: write cold outreach emails, subject lines, follow-ups and LinkedIn connection requests or messages. Use it when nobody replies to your sales emails (paste one to see why and get a rewrite), a prospect went quiet after your first email and needs a follow-up, your emails land in spam or junk, or you have notes about a prospect or a page you link and want a personalized first line. Checks an email, merge fields, opt-out line and pasted SPF, DKIM and DMARC records before you send; helps pick who to email first and whether your offer is ready. Uses only facts you give; never sends email, finds addresses or adds contacts. Network use: cold-email-hooks reads up to 3 public pages you link. Answers that rest on sender, email-law or LinkedIn rules cite the official page used (for example Google, yahooinc.com, Microsoft, ftc.gov, legislation.gov.uk, ico.org.uk, LinkedIn) for you to open; because those rules are dated, it may also offer to check the most recent dated copy on the author's page, https://black-vector.com/cold-email/deliverability, and fetches that page only after you say yes.

interface.shortDescription: Write, review and check cold emails
interface.longDescription: Five skills for careful one-to-one business outreach. Write a short sequence from your offer, built only from facts you give. Review a cold email and get the rewrite first, with every number, name and claim kept, then what changed and why; an editorial score on request. Check an email before you send it: merge fields across up to 25 sample rows, sender identity, postal address and opt-out lines, country rules, and what the SPF, DKIM or DMARC records you paste do and do not cover. Check whether an offer is ready, and turn your prospect notes, or up to 3 public pages you link, into dated opening lines. Nothing is sent and no address is looked up. Network use: cold-email-hooks reads up to 3 public pages you link. Answers that rest on sender, email-law or LinkedIn rules cite the official page used (for example Google, yahooinc.com, Microsoft, ftc.gov, legislation.gov.uk, ico.org.uk, LinkedIn) for you to open; because those rules are dated, it may also offer to check the most recent dated copy on the author's page, https://black-vector.com/cold-email/deliverability, and fetches that page only after you say yes.
